extraction: Anthropic multi-agent value criteria: multi-agent adds value when (1) task complexity > single agent context window, (2) subtasks need different tools/skills, (3) independent verification improves quality, (4) parallel execution reduces latency. Our campaign: (1) 18 langs × engine configs > context, (2) Engine=build tools, Verdict=verify tools, Miss=patch tools, (3) Verdict independent review catches Engine blind spots, (4) Staggered engines parallel. All four TRUE — multi-agent justified.
decision_it_changes: W6 rollout: Anthropic criteria confirm our 3-agent model adds value, not overhead
transfer_harness_fact: 18 Indic langs, weak cells, 200-dpi citizen docs, no paid keys, no training until W6 freeze, offline pipeline
